_note: Reference example for direct multi-dataset CLI runs: copy it, edit every "TODO..." value (submit_bids_cohort.sh refuses to run while any remain) and replace YOUR_USER, then `bash scripts/submit_bids_cohort.sh setup -c <your copy>`. The GUI's 'BIDS App Cohort' panel does not read this file: it generates its own per-project config from the loaded project (see prism_app_runner._derive_cohort_config). ALL bulk data -- input clones, derivatives, scratch, logs, subject lists -- belongs on the large shared scratch filesystem (/cl_tmp/YOUR_USER/...), never on the home filesystem, which has no quota for it. The datalad URL templates use an ssh alias from your ~/.ssh/config plus the server's base path (the same values as PRISM_REMOTE_SSH_HOST / PRISM_REMOTE_BASE_PATH in site.env).
